issue.title: [reboot] Fail to start Arista early platform initialization

failure.body:
**Description**

**Steps to reproduce the issue:**
1. Upgrade a DUT(Arista7060) to the latest master image
```
admin@sonic:~$ sudo sonic_installer install http://<server_ip>/broadcom/public/sonic-aboot-broadcom.swi
```
2. Run `show version`
3. Restart `platform-arista-swss.service`

**Describe the results you received:**
* during reboot, there is an error:
```
[FAILED] Failed to start Arista early platform initialization.
See 'systemctl status platform-arista-swss.service' for details.
[   37.629895] <HOSTNAME>[532]: + SONIC_CONFIG_DIR=/host/image-HEAD.101-3e717210/sonic-config
```

* Arista early platform initialization should start without errors.

**Additional information you deem important (e.g. issue happens only occasionally):**

resolution.title: [Arista] Update driver submodules
resolution.description:
- Enhance eeprom parsing robustness on corrupted fields (fixes #6138)
 - Add chassis provisioning service
 - Disable CPU sleep state on some systems
 - Complete refactor for FanSlots
 - Fix module unload while still in use
